name: MoUtils
subtitle: Offline utilities with on-device AI
localizedDescription: A privacy-first toolkit: offline developer, file and system utilities, plus on-device AI chat and a local agent with built-in tools. Models run on your device and nothing is sent to cloud model providers.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app requires local network access for model inference services.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app requires camera access to capture images for AI vision workflows.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app requires photo library access to select images for AI vision workflows.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app requires microphone access to record audio for AI audio workflows.
